title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Altoura** 




  





 Altoura builds enterprise software for creating, managing, and delivering interactive training across web, mobile, and immersive devices. Altoura vNext brings VR training, procedure training, and e\-learning into a modern web\-based platform with shared content, reusable scenes and assets, and AI\-assisted authoring.
 



  





 Our product ecosystem includes a browser\-based Authoring Platform and Trainee Client, a Unity\-based trainee application for head\-mounted devices such as Meta Quest, Microsoft HoloLens, and HTC Vive, and mobile applications for iOS and Android. Designers work across complex enterprise workflows, 3D interactions, spatial interfaces, and conventional 2D user experiences.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer who combines strong product thinking with polished visual execution. You will lead the design of complex workflows across Altoura vNext and our cross\-platform trainee experiences, working closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers from early discovery through implementation.
 



  





 This role is well suited to a designer who enjoys turning technically complex capabilities—such as visual authoring, branching training logic, 3D scene interaction, asset management, timelines, AI\-assisted workflows, and enterprise administration—into clear and approachable experiences.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  




* Own end\-to\-end design for major product areas, from problem definition and user flows to high\-fidelity UI, prototypes, specifications, and implementation review.
* Design sophisticated authoring workflows for creating VR training, procedures, e\-learning, branching logic, assessments, media, and interactions with 3D objects.
* Create coherent trainee experiences across desktop and tablet browsers, iOS and Android applications, and Unity\-based applications running on Meta Quest, Microsoft HoloLens, and HTC Vive.
* Translate differences in device capabilities and input methods—mouse, touch, controllers, hand tracking, and spatial interaction—into appropriate platform\-specific patterns.
* Contribute to and evolve the Altoura Design System, including reusable components, interaction states, responsive behavior, accessibility guidance, and patterns for enterprise workflows.
* Partner closely with engineering to align designs with shadcn\-based web components, technical constraints, and reusable implementation patterns.
* Plan and conduct user research, usability testing, workflow validation, and design critiques; turn findings into practical product improvements.
* Use prototyping and AI\-assisted tools to explore concepts, communicate behavior, and accelerate iteration while maintaining sound design judgment.
* Provide clear design rationale, document decisions, and communicate effectively with distributed product and engineering teams.
* Mentor junior designers and help raise the quality and consistency of the team’s work.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  




* 4–6 years of professional experience in UI/UX, product design, or a closely related role.
* A portfolio that demonstrates end\-to\-end product thinking, strong interaction design, polished UI craft, and measurable problem solving.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, interactive prototypes, and design\-system workflows.
* Experience designing complex SaaS, enterprise, dashboard, workflow, content\-creation, or productivity products.
* A strong command of information architecture, interaction patterns, responsive design, accessibility, and usability principles.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts without removing essential capability or flexibility.
* Experience collaborating directly with product managers and engineers throughout implementation, not only during design handoff.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and respond constructively to feedback.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and take ownership in an office\-based, cross\-functional environment.



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Experience with 3D, XR, VR, AR, gaming, simulation, spatial computing, or Unity\-based products.
* Familiarity with shadcn, React component systems, or close collaboration with front\-end engineering teams.
* Experience designing AI\-assisted creation tools, visual editors, node\-based workflows, timeline editors, or learning\-management products.
* Knowledge of mobile platform conventions for iOS and Android.
* Experience mentoring designers or contributing to a growing design practice.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  




* You can independently lead a complex feature from discovery to a production\-ready design.
* Users can understand and complete difficult authoring or training tasks with less friction and fewer errors.
* Designs remain coherent across web, mobile, and immersive platforms while respecting the strengths of each device.
* New patterns strengthen the shared design system instead of becoming one\-off solutions.
* Engineering teams receive clear, feasible designs and benefit from active design partnership during implementation.

title: Interior Designer
description:
**1\. ROLE PURPOSE** 




 The Interior Designer is responsible for managing assigned interior design projects from concept development through design documentation and execution coordination. The role combines design excellence, client interaction, team management, documentation, and coordination with site, purchase, vendors, and other internal teams.
 



**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • 
 **Design \& Concept Development:** 
  Develop concepts, space planning, mood boards, material palettes, colour schemes, presentations, and detailed interior drawings.
 



 • Prepare and coordinate furniture layouts, flooring layouts, ceiling plans, electrical and lighting layouts, wall elevations, furniture details, partitions, and execution details.
 



 • Ensure designs are practical, aesthetically strong, budget\-conscious, and execution\-friendly.
 



 • 
 **Client Interaction:** 
  Understand client requirements, present designs professionally, conduct meetings, record feedback, manage expectations, and obtain timely approvals.
 



 • 
 **Team Management:** 
  Allocate tasks to junior designers/interns, review their work, monitor deadlines, provide guidance, and maintain design quality.
 



 • 
 **Internal Coordination:** 
  Coordinate with Principal Designer, Junior Designers, Site Supervisors, Project Manager,Purchase/Procurement, Accounts, vendors, and contractors.
 



 • 
 **Site Coordination:** 
  Conduct site visits, review execution against approved drawings, resolve design queries,identify deviations, and coordinate corrective actions.
 



 • 
 **Material \& Vendor Coordination:** 
  Assist with material selection, samples, specifications, vendor discussions, and verification of materials against approved designs.
 



 • 
 **BOQ \& Cost Coordination:** 
  Assist with quantities and specifications, coordinate with the purchase/project team and propose cost\-effective alternatives where required.
 



 • 
 **Documentation:** 
  Maintain approved drawings, revisions, material selections, client comments, site instructions, and other project records with proper revision control.
 



 • 
 **Project Ownership:** 
  Take ownership of assigned projects from brief → design → client approval → coordination →execution support → handover.
 



**3\. DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • Review project priorities, deadlines, and pending approvals.
 



 • Complete assigned design and drawing work within committed timelines.
 



 • Update the daily task/reporting sheet.
 



 • Follow up with clients and internal teams for pending decisions and approvals.
 



 • Coordinate with junior designers and site teams.
 



 • Resolve design\-related site queries promptly.
 



 • Keep project documentation and drawing revisions updated.
 



 • Report progress, risks, delays, and pending decisions to the reporting manager.

 • Plan priorities for the following working day.
 




**4\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)** 




 • Quality and creativity of design output.
 



 • Timely completion of drawings, presentations, and assigned deliverables.
 



 • Client satisfaction and professionalism of communication.
 



 • Accuracy of drawings and reduction of avoidable errors/revisions.
 



 • Timely follow\-up for client approvals and decisions.
 



 • Effective delegation, supervision, and development of junior team members.
 



 • Speed and effectiveness in resolving site/design issues.
 



 • Accuracy and completeness of project documentation.
 



 • Material knowledge, cost awareness, and execution feasibility.
 



 • Overall ownership and coordination of assigned projects.
 



**5\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& KNOWLEDGE** 




 • 
 **Software:** 
  AutoCAD, SketchUp/3D software, Photoshop/Illustrator or equivalent, and MS Office/Google Workspace.
 



 • Good knowledge of furniture detailing, materials, finishes, lighting, ceiling systems, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other interior services.
 



 • Strong client communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Team leadership, time management, problem solving, negotiation, and attention to detail.
 



 • Ability to work under deadlines and coordinate multiple projects/tasks.
 



**6\. AUTHORITY \& ACCOUNTABILITY** 




 • Responsible for the design and coordination of assigned projects within the approved brief and company process.
 



 • Major design changes, additional costs, vendor commitments, and significant timeline commitments must be discussed with and approved by the Principal Designer/Management.
 



 • No drawing should be issued for execution without appropriate internal review, client approval where applicable, and revision control.
 



**7\. IDEAL CANDIDATE** 




 The ideal candidate should think like a designer but work like a project owner. They should be capable of understanding a brief, developing a strong design, presenting it to the client, coordinating the internal team,maintaining documentation, and supporting the site team through successful execution.
